items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Well, the trumpets was Al Killian, Shelton Hemphill, Francis Williams, Shorty Baker, and Ray Nance.

ctx.x: Well, when you joined that band, who was in that band?
Well, the trumpets was Al Killian, Shelton Hemphill, Francis Williams, Shorty Baker, and Ray Nance.

items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: We used to call him Scad Hemphill. Scad played -- he used to play first trumpet with Lucky Millinder for a long time, too.

ctx.x: What happened to Shelton Hemphill? I don't remember him.
Shelton Hemphill got sick. He had a stroke and he got sick and died. We used to call him Scad Hemphill.
